description_short: Create forestry designations with one click. See forestry information. Order vehicles and pool trucks on tower level.
description_long:
Auto Forestry Designations

Automatically creates forestry designations for your forestry towers - no manual painting required.

- Create designations: Scan the tower area and place valid forestry designations.
- Clear designations: Remove forestry designations in the selected tower area without touching other designation types.
- World and tower settings: Control terrain-designation overrides, fertile-only placement, existing trees, flat terrain, target yield, and marking grown trees for harvest.
- Vehicle enqueueing: Enqueue vehicle construction directly for tower assignments, automatically routed to the closest depot by driving distance (ordered vehicles are pre-assigned and join the tower automatically once completed).

Compatible with vanilla saves - can be added to or removed from existing saves safely.
